description: Single panel with many horizontally aligned rectangles arranged in rows. Each row contains two opposing rectangles that meet at a central vertical boundary—one extending left and one extending right. Rows are stacked with narrow gaps, forming a mirrored/diverging set of bars across the vertical space. Only rectangles encode data; other elements (gridlines/labels/axes) are ignored.

primary.explanation: Many rows stacked vertically; each row is a pair of opposing bars.

secondary.explanation: Two rectangles per row: one extends left and one extends right from the center.
